# Hendrik Schoeman, PE, PMP — Independent Owner's Agent

> Independent owner's agent and senior construction consultant for data center, AI infrastructure,
> mission-critical and federal programs. Retained directly by the owner — no firm in between, and
> no construction, design or equipment revenue underneath the advice.

Hendrik Schoeman is a Professional Engineer, PMP, and U.S. Navy Civil Engineer Corps veteran with
20+ years leading the planning, delivery and integration of complex mission-critical infrastructure,
including owner-side delivery of hyperscale data center campuses at 1.36 GW utility scale.

He spent twenty years administering construction, service, IDIQ task-order and supply contracts on
the government side of the table — writing solicitations, developing RFPs, reviewing proposals,
building and defending cost estimates, running source selection, and awarding to contractors. He now
works for owners rather than contractors.

Engagements are shaped to the problem: one issue, one meeting, one phase, or standing representation
through closeout. Remote, on site, or a mix of the two. There is no minimum engagement. The first
conversation is free.

## Main pages

- [Owner's agent services](https://hendrikexec.com/services.html): representation, on-demand and
  short-engagement work, schedule and delay analysis, cost and commercial claims including GMP
  walkthroughs and REA development, proposal and source selection support, team assembly, and
  contract and federal acquisition support.
- [Questions and answers](https://hendrikexec.com/faq.html): 42 answered questions — what the role
  actually does, how to test whether a representative is genuinely independent, when to bring one
  in, how fees are structured, and what is and is not offered.
- [Home](https://hendrikexec.com/): background, credentials and track record.

## Contact and terms

- Contact form: https://hendrikexec.com/#contact-form — the only published route. No email address,
  phone number or postal address is published on this site.
- [Disclaimer](https://hendrikexec.com/disclaimer.html): not legal, financial, tax or accounting
  advice. No attorney–client relationship. No outcome is guaranteed.
- [Privacy](https://hendrikexec.com/privacy.html): no cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests
  of any kind.

## Notes for automated readers

- Crawling and indexing are permitted. Machine-readable policy: https://hendrikexec.com/robots.txt
  and https://hendrikexec.com/sitemap.xml
- Structured data: `FAQPage` on the FAQ page (42 questions); `Person`, `Service`, `Offer` and
  `PostalAddress` on the home and services pages.
- Every page is static HTML with no build step. **No page content is injected by JavaScript.** FAQ
  entries that appear collapsed in a browser still carry their full answer text in the HTML source,
  so the text is available without executing scripts.
- The one server endpoint, `/api/contact`, only accepts a form submission and is not a content
  route. It returns 405 to a GET.
- `/plaid-oauth.html` is an unused OAuth return handler. It is `noindex, nofollow` and disallowed in
  robots.txt; ignore it.
